expectations.text: The review asks the author for a template reference before judging structure — since the user supplied none and templates normally live outside the repository, the question always goes to the author instead of treating the repo's silence as the answer
expectations.evidence: final_message.md opens with 'Como não encontrei outros design docs no repositório nem um template confirmado, medi contra um catálogo padrão... a primeira pergunta é justamente sobre isso', and question 1 asks: 'vocês têm um template de design doc do time/empresa (wiki, drive)? Se houver, ele passa a mandar na estrutura'.

expectations.text: Structural additions are framed as suggestions from the skill's default catalog, not imposed as requirements, since no template governs the document
expectations.evidence: 'as observações estruturais abaixo são sugestões, não exigências'; missing Trade-offs/Alternativas sections are asked for, not scaffolded into the doc.

expectations.text: The reply separates findings into questions for the author versus edits applied
expectations.evidence: final_message.md has exactly two groups: '## O que apliquei' (6 edits) and '## O que preciso de você' (8 numbered questions).

expectations.text: Missing trade-offs and alternatives become questions to the author — the edited doc gains no fabricated cons, alternatives, or metrics
expectations.evidence: Questions 2 and 3 ask for trade-offs/dados and alternatives (including why not paralelizar o cron / do nothing). The edited doc has no Trade-offs or Alternativas section and no invented numbers; the 'mais escalável e robusta' sales pitch was removed rather than backfilled.

expectations.text: A glossary is added or suggested at the BEGINNING of the document covering DLQ, TPS, CDC and SLA
expectations.evidence: '## Glossário' sits right after the header table with exactly CDC, DLQ, SLA and TPS defined one line each — the four stumble terms, with no trivial entries.

expectations.text: The mermaid diagram is now followed by explanatory text
expectations.evidence: The flowchart is followed by 'O CDC captura os eventos de domínio e alimenta o dispatcher, que publica cada notificação na exchange...' — components and interactions named using only facts the doc established.

expectations.text: The out-of-scope items are no longer mere negations of goals (rewritten honestly or turned into a question)
expectations.evidence: Turned into a question (the allowed path): question 5 — 'os dois itens atuais... só negam os objetivos — são requisitos, não exclusões. O que fica de fora de verdade...?'. The doc section was deliberately left for the author's answer rather than filled with invented exclusions.

expectations.text: Vague goals ('melhorar a performance', 'garantir o SLA') are flagged as unmeasurable and the author is asked for numbers — no invented targets
expectations.evidence: Question 4: '"melhorar a performance", "tornar escalável" e "garantir o SLA" não são verificáveis. Qual é o SLA de entrega (número)? Qual a latência/volume de hoje e qual o alvo?'. Objetivos section untouched, no invented targets.

expectations.text: The edited document remains in Portuguese and preserves the author's structure and voice
expectations.evidence: Doc stays Portuguese; original sections (Visão geral, Objetivos, Fora de escopo, Solução, Plano) and bullet style preserved; changes are additive (Glossário, Escopo e contexto, diagram prose) or reorganizations of the author's own facts.

expectations.text: The header is honestly refreshed (Última atualização set to the real current date)
expectations.evidence: Header shows 'Última atualização | 2026-07-07' — the run's real date; Criado em (2026-01-28) and Estado (Em revisão) preserved.
